description: Compare two images pixel by pixel (pixelmatch, anti-aliasing aware) and write a diff PNG with changed pixels in red over a faded copy of the first image. Returns the number and percentage of different pixels. Images must be the same size unless resize is true (the second is stretched to the first's size). Reads PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, GIF (first frame), TIFF and SVG; file path or base64; up to 50 MP. Good for visual regression checks.

a.description: The first (reference) image: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

b.description: The second image: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

includeAA.description: Count anti-aliased edge pixels as differences too. Default false.

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

resize.description: Resize the second image to the first one's size when they differ (otherwise that is an error).

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

threshold.description: Colour difference tolerance 0..1; smaller is stricter. Default 0.1.

name: ai_image_diff
title: Compare two images
